title: Add CourseReview skill variant for interactive study sessions
description:
Adds a study-oriented skill variant to process, not a separate command. The session is exploratory-first rather than synthesis-first, but vault changes are optional output, not the primary goal.

## Use case

Student wants to talk to Claude about course material to cement understanding and get quizzed. If the conversation surfaces a gap or produces a good articulation of a concept, the student wants that captured in the vault automatically — not rely on manually feeding highlights back in.

## Design (Option B)

This is a process session with a new SkillVariant (CourseReview), not a separate command. That means:
- Full existing process/commit/report loop is reused unchanged
- Workspace is built via the CourseScope from L52
- Ops in the report are optional — the AI may emit none, or may emit CreateNote/UpdateNote if the conversation surfaces something worth capturing
- The skill prompt opens with exploration: 'help the student understand and review this material; quiz them, answer questions, surface gaps' — and closes with: 'if anything from this conversation would make a good atomic note or improvement, emit ops for those'
- No new command needed; invoked as: csnotes process --course CPSC5002 --skill course-review (or similar flag)

## What this is NOT

Not a no-op read-only session. The vault loop stays intact so genuine discoveries get captured without requiring the student to remember to do it themselves.

## Skill prompt considerations

- Opening directive should be exploration/conversation, not 'process these notes'
- Ops should be emitted only when something genuinely new or improved was found — not forced synthesis
- The AI should be told explicitly that zero ops is a valid outcome

## Depends on

L52 (course-scoped workspace assembly)
